56/S0.subgoal: Explain the necessity of computer graphics in creating immersive VR experiences.

56/S1.subgoal: Describe the five stages of the 3D graphics pipeline.

56/S2.subgoal: Explain the concept of modeling transformation and its basic operations.

56/S3.subgoal: Describe how transformations are represented using homogeneous matrices.

56/S4.subgoal: Demonstrate how to calculate a composite transformation matrix for complex scene objects.

56/S5.subgoal: Differentiate between lighting and shading models and explain the conceptual basis of color in 3D graphics.

56/S6.subgoal: Define the components and coefficients of the simple lighting model.

56/S7.subgoal: Calculate the diffuse and specular reflection components using the simple lighting model.

56/S8.subgoal: Analyze how intensity attenuation and colored light sources modify the standard lighting model.

56/S9.subgoal: Describe the process of mapping computed intensity values to finite device-supported levels.

56/S10.subgoal: Summarize the computational steps involved in modeling transformation and lighting.
